expected_symptom: A closest-hit shader mutates its inout payload and then calls TraceRay with it; the mutation does not reach the recursive trace. Copying into a local Payload first, tracing with that, and assigning back is reported to work. DXIL only; SPIR-V unaffected.
reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet independent review (batch-012 step-10; blind 3414)
summary: Fixed. From v1.6.2104 to v1.8.2502 (13 consecutive stable releases) DXC passed a closest-hit shader's own inout payload object straight to dx.op.traceRay instead of a copy, eliding the copy-in/copy-out that inout requires; on the same broken binary the reporter's workaround variant gets a distinct temporary. Clean on v1.4.1907 and v1.5.2010 and on every release from v1.8.2505 onward. Likely fixed by 053e7ac65 (PR #7440), which moves UDT intrinsic arg copy-in/copy-out ahead of SROA and adds a test for a payload passed as a pointer parameter - strong but not certain, 162-commit window. Nothing was executed on a GPU.
text_stale: A maintainer comment, not the body. The body was accurate when filed (2021-02) and the defect is now fixed. The standing 2023-07-14 comment "The DXIL generation looks correct to me. We are generating a store to the payload" predates the v1.8.2505 fix: trunk of that date emitted both a store to the payload and a dx.op.traceRay taking that same payload object.
title: DXIL Modifying recursive payload does not work
